notes.title: Free Music Update on Sept 24 — Shirobon + Future Funk Squad!
notes.content:
Hi all,



On September 24th I'll be updating all versions of Beat Hazard to include some great new tracks.



First we have 5 amazing chip-tune tracks from Shirobon



I've also been working with Future Funk Squad who have worked with Nine Inch Nails, Sia and U2. They have made an exclusive track for Beat Hazard, and I'm really excited for everyone to play it. I'm so privileged to be able to work with a top flight artist!



On Sept 24th, Beat Hazard returns to PlayStation. Details here 


I'm gaging interest on a Steam release of Beat Hazard Arcade. It would have full VR support, and be a streamlined Arcade Beat Hazard experience. It would have some new weapons and enemies, and focus on community leaderboards. I'm interested to hear some feedback. 


Happy Hazarding!

Cheers,

Steve.

notes.title: Happy 15th Birthday Beat Hazard
notes.content:
Hi all,

This week marks the 15th Birthday of Beat Hazard being released on Steam.
To all players new and old, thank you so much for all the support during that time. It's been amazing. 
The game is on sale right now, so be sure to spread the word!

On to the update:
- Fixed lighting issues 
- Added a debris level option, choose from low, med & high. (I love a ton of debris flying off damaged ships, so I have mine on high, but I know it's not everyone's cup of tea.)
- Fixed issue with snakes not dying when on tail section is left.

These changes have been brought over from the PlayStation port I'm working on. It's called Beat Hazard Arcade and is a streamlined version of the game. It should be out in a few months.

Take care everyone, have a great day!

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: Screen Rez Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

Yet another update for screen rez issues.
Let me know if there are any problems.

I've added launch commands to force the rez you want if need be:
Launch options:
-Res [number] (number is the X size. The game will auto calculate a 16:9 size)
-Fullscreen (Optional. Force full screen)
-BFullscreen (Optional. Force borderless full screen)

e.g. -Res 1280 

If you have a problem, can you run with -log and post your debug.txt in the bugs forum?

Thanks
Steve.

notes.title: Phase 4+5 Release: Galaxy Gameplay!
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is a major Phase 4+5 Galaxy Gameplay update!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/de066b31320096d63e0435dccc743325e23ee57e.png

A lot of new features for galaxy play, including:

- A Galaxy Directory: making it easier to publish and find galaxies.

- Galaxy Challenges: Created by the game. 3 active at any time. Can be found in the Galaxy Directory

- Gameplay rules: Galaxies now have rules and objectives. They can be PvP or PvE. PvP can be solo or teams.

- Galaxy Reward Ship: Win powerful Galaxy Elite Ships, They come in classes 1,2 or 3. 1 being the best. You can win these in PvE or PvP Galaxies

I've added a lot to the in game instructions explaining these new features in more detail.

Here's a video also explaining them:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gj7_ji5CD4I

Any and all feedback welcome. There are a lot of changes that might need some balancing and bug fixing.

QOL Changes:

- Removal of Uranium fuel and sublight engines. There is now no cost to just travel from planet to planet in a solar system. This just seemed to be a pain, so I removed it. Now, you only need Fold Crystals for interstellar travel.

- Added Auto Aim option: Settings -> Game Settings
- Added separate settings for in game music and menu music volumes.

I hope you enjoy the new update!
Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: New 'Ship Tuning' system added to Test build.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/13cbfc3b4ac2650bbb05879da078d19e86b4ec99.png

I've just updated the 'test' build to include the brand new 'Ship Tuning' feature. (This replaces the BH2 ship modules system)
In addition to the usual stats, I've added:

- Bullet Penetration: A % chance that any give bullet will cause damage and bounce off the enemy to go on and cause more damage.
- Scale. You can now change the base size of your ship!
- Dark Beam Strength & Dark Beam Duration
- Resource Pickup Force: Making Scrap, Uranium & Crystals to be attracted to your ship.
- Beam Sweep Size: Alter the sweep size of your beams, making it more focused, or more scattered.
- Beam Sweep Angle: Alter the base angle offsets for the beams.

There are still some bits to finished off and tidy up. Interested on feedback.
Hop on to the 'testing' branch in Betas to try it out.

I hope you enjoy.
Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: Phase 3 Test Build
notes.content:
Hi all,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/f78b19363c18a4e11d5a90254259a7c6276923cf.png

I have an early phase 3 build: Ancient Aliens. If you want to try it out, hop on the Steam 'testing' branch. (Choose using Right click on BH3->Properties->Betas, and select 'Testing')
This version is all about galaxies:

-  Galaxies now contain different 'Artefacts'
-  These can be found by visiting a system or
-  By using the new 'Galactic Scan' feature. You will need to add up to 4 Galactic Scan modules to your mother ship.
-  You can see in the screen shot I have made a number of scans to reveal where artefacts are.
-   To get the artefact, you need to fly to the Planet and beat the track.

Artefacts are as follows:

1: Scrap cache. Get a big pile of scrap for your stores
2: Uranium fuel
3: Fold Crystals. Making it a lot easier to hop around the galaxy
4: Nano Tech Cache. Used to quickly upgrade weapons, or make a long range scan
5: Alien Blueprint. Used to unlock new weapons. (Not currently implemented)
6: Wraith Empire Elite Ship. Cool and powerful ships seemingly discarded by an ancient race of aliens. 

Start a new galaxy, or join me in the one above. ID: 17309151
